Description: Flagstaff is a high-elevation mountain city in Coconino County, Arizona, anchored by Northern Arizona University, pine forests, and outdoor recreation near the San Francisco Peaks and Grand Canyon. It features in-city VA outpatient access, an active arts and optics/tech community, and strong LGBTQ friendliness, balanced by a high cost of housing and snowy winters.
